notes: College of Arts and Humanities' Linguistics - Grammars & Cognition Four Year Academic Plan. The source PDF's term grid converts to garbled, column-interleaved text (Fall/Spring/benchmark-sidebar cells run together on each line), so exact per-slot Fall/Spring placement could not be reliably reconstructed; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. The plan's own benchmark sidebar confirms the full course list matches the catalog exactly (LING200/240/311/321, PHIL170 x1 (also satisfying the AR Gen Ed, hence its two mentions), 'two of LING312/320/322/410/440/444', LING350/PHIL360 x1, 'LING/PSYC/HESP/PHIL/CMSC 1xx-4xx' x2, 'LING 3xx-4xx' x3), so no course was invented to fill an unnamed placeholder; only the term (year/semester) each falls in is a best-effort reconstruction, placed by benchmark order (LING200/240 by benchmark 1; LING311/321 and PHIL170 by benchmark 2; the remaining track and elective slots after). Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.
'Select two of LING312, LING322, LING320, LING410, LING440, LING444' filled with LING312 and LING322.

'Three 3xx-4xx level LING electives' (no course-to-slot list in either source) filled with LING330, LING420, LING451, all from the Academic Catalog's approved-course list the main session supplied for plan slots.

'Select two approved electives in LING, PSYC, HESP, PHIL, or CMSC' (no number range given) filled with PSYC300 and HESP300, both real courses already used elsewhere in this codebase (psyc-major-ba-2026-27.ts, hesp-major-2026-27.ts).
